source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 8 (PDF 174-191), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 8 (Physical Optics and Gravitational Waves) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 The two major areas of physics dealt with in this chapter are:
(Is chapter mein physics ke kaun se do bare shobay (areas) parhaye gaye hain?)

options.text: transverse waves ki polarization aur gravitational waves

blocks.explanation: Chapter transverse waves ki polarization aur gravitational waves (kashish ki lehrein) se mutaliq hai (8.1).

book_ref.quote: This chapter deals with two major areas of physics namely polarization of transverse waves

blocks.prompt:
2 Interference and diffraction of light prove that light:
(Light ka interference aur diffraction kya sabit karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Interference aur diffraction light ki wave nature (lehri fitrat) sabit karte hain, magar yeh nahi batate ke lehrein longitudinal hain ya transverse (8.1).

book_ref.quote: Interference and diffraction effects prove the wave nature of light.

blocks.prompt:
3 Which phenomenon shows that light waves are transverse in character?
(Kaun sa amal (phenomenon) dikhata hai ke light ki lehrein transverse hain?)
blocks.explanation: Light ki polarization batati hai ke light waves transverse (arzi) hain (8.1).

book_ref.quote: Polarization of light suggests that the light waves are transverse in character.

blocks.prompt:
4 In a transverse mechanical wave on a stretched string, the particles of the medium vibrate:
(Tani hui string par transverse mechanical wave mein medium ke zarraat kis tarah vibrate karte hain?)

options.text: lehar ke chalne ki simt ke saath
lehar ki simt mein daairon mein
lehar ke chalne ki simt ke amoodan (perpendicular)

blocks.explanation: Transverse waves mein zarraat ki vibration lehar ke chalne ki simt ke amoodan (perpendicular) hoti hai (8.1).

book_ref.quote: the vibrations of the particles of the medium are perpendicular to the direction of propagation

blocks.prompt:
5 The plane of polarization is the plane containing:
(Plane of polarization (polarization ki satah) kin do cheezon par mushtamil satah hai?)

options.text: vibration ki simt aur lehar ke chalne ki simt

blocks.explanation: Plane of polarization mein zarraat ki vibration ki simt aur lehar ke chalne ki simt dono hoti hain (8.1).

book_ref.quote: The plane of polarization is the plane containing the direction of vibration

blocks.prompt:
6 In a light wave produced by an oscillating charge, the electric field vector E and the magnetic field vector B are:
(Hilte hue charge se bani light wave mein electric field vector E aur magnetic field vector B aapas mein kaise hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Light wave mein E ke saath B hota hai aur dono aapas mein qaima zaviya (90°) par hote hain (8.1).

book_ref.quote: accompanied by the magnetic field vector B at right angle to each other

blocks.prompt:
7 Light which has components of vibration in all possible planes is called:
(Jis light ki vibration ke components tamam mumkina satahon mein hon, use kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Aam light ki vibrations har satah mein hoti hain; aisi light unpolarized hoti hai (8.1).

book_ref.quote: Ordinary light has components of vibration in all possible planes.

blocks.prompt:
8 Light is said to be polarized when its vibrations are:
(Light ko polarized kab kaha jata hai?)

options.text: sirf aik satah tak mehdood hon
lehar ki simt ke saath hon

blocks.explanation: Jab vibrations sirf aik satah (plane) tak mehdood hon to light polarized kehlati hai (8.1).

book_ref.quote: if the vibrations are confined only in one plane, the light is said to be polarized

blocks.prompt:
9 Which one of the following is NOT listed as a source of unpolarized light?
(In mein se kaun sa unpolarized light ka source nahi bataya gaya?)
blocks.explanation: Sooraj, incandescent aur fluorescent bulb, mombatti aur aag unpolarized light dete hain; polarizing chashmon se guzri light linearly polarized hoti hai (8.1, 8.2).

book_ref.quote: Examples of unpolarized light sources are sunlight, incandescent light bulbs

blocks.prompt:
10 Polarization cannot occur for:
(Polarization kis ke liye nahi ho sakti?)
blocks.explanation: Polarization sirf transverse waves dikhati hain; sound jaisi longitudinal waves mein yeh nahi hoti (8.1).

book_ref.quote: It does not occur for longitudinal waves such as sound waves.

blocks.prompt:
11 Polarization is the process by which the electric and magnetic vibrations of light waves are:
(Polarization woh amal hai jis mein light ki electric aur magnetic vibrations ko:)

options.text: har satah mein phaila diya jata hai
aik hi satah tak mehdood kiya jata hai

blocks.explanation: Polarization light ki electric aur magnetic vibrations ko aik hi satah tak mehdood kar deti hai (8.1).

book_ref.quote: Polarization is the process by which the electric and magnetic vibrations of light waves are restricted

blocks.prompt:
12 Which of these is NOT a method of polarizing unpolarized light mentioned in the chapter?
(In mein se kaun sa tareeqa chapter mein unpolarized light ko polarize karne ka nahi bataya gaya?)

options.text: Saada sheeshe ke lens se guzarna
Calcite ya quartz jaise crystals istemal karna

blocks.explanation: Bataye gaye tareeqay: polarizing filter (polaroid sheet), polarizing beam splitter, aur calcite ya quartz jaise crystals (8.1).

book_ref.quote: Employing certain optical crystals or materials

blocks.prompt:
13 When unpolarized light passes through a polarizing filter, the electric field vectors that pass through are those:
(Jab unpolarized light polarizing filter se guzarti hai to kaun se electric field vectors guzarte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Sirf woh electric field vector guzarta hai jo filter ke axis ke mutawazi (parallel) ho; baqi ruk jaate hain (8.1).

book_ref.quote: only that electric field vector which is parallel to the axis of polarized filter

blocks.prompt:
14 The most common method of polarizing unpolarized light is:
(Unpolarized light ko polarize karne ka sab se aam tareeqa kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sab se aam tareeqa light ko polaroid sheet jaise polarizing filter se guzarna hai (8.1).

book_ref.quote: The most common method by which an unpolarized light can be polarized

blocks.prompt:
15 The basis of polarization is the orientation, in a specific direction, of the light wave's:
(Polarization ki bunyad light wave ki kis cheez ka aik khaas simt mein hona hai?)
blocks.explanation: Electric field vector E ka aik khaas simt mein hona polarization ki bunyad hai (8.1).

book_ref.quote: The orientation of the electric field vector E of light waves in a specific direction

blocks.prompt:
16 When the electric field vector of light oscillates in a single plane, the light is:
(Jab light ka electric field vector aik hi satah mein hilta hai to light kaisi hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: E ka aik hi satah mein hilna linear polarization hai (8.2).

book_ref.quote: When the electric field vector oscillates in a single plane

blocks.prompt:
17 Light passing through polarizing sunglasses is an example of:
(Polarizing sunglasses se guzarne wali light kis ki misaal hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sunglasses jaise polarizing filter se guzri light linearly polarized hoti hai (8.2).

book_ref.quote: Example is the light passing through a polarizing filter, like sunglasses.

blocks.prompt:
18 Circularly polarized light whose electric field rotates clockwise is called:
(Woh circularly polarized light jis ka electric field clockwise ghoomta hai, kya kehlati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Clockwise ghoomna right-handed aur counterclockwise left-handed circular polarization hai (8.2).

book_ref.quote: When the electric field rotates circularly, either clockwise (right-handed)

blocks.prompt:
19 Light reflected off a CD or DVD is given as an example of:
(CD ya DVD se reflect hone wali light kis ki misaal hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chapter CD ya DVD se reflect hui light ko circular polarization ki misaal batata hai (8.2).

book_ref.quote: Example is the light reflected off a CD

blocks.prompt:
20 A combination of linear and circular polarization in which the electric field vector traces an elliptical path is:
(Linear aur circular polarization ka milaap jis mein electric field vector bezawi (elliptical) raasta banata hai, kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jab E elliptical raasta banaye to light elliptically polarized hoti hai (8.2).

book_ref.quote: the electric field vector traces an elliptical path is called elliptical polarization

blocks.prompt:
21 In elliptical polarization, the two components Ex and Ey of the electric field:
(Elliptical polarization mein electric field ke do components Ex aur Ey kaise hote hain?)

options.text: barabar nahi aur/ya un mein kisi bhi angle ka phase farq hota hai
hamesha barabar aur aik phase mein

blocks.explanation: Elliptical polarization mein Ex aur Ey barabar nahi hote aur/ya un mein kisi bhi angle θ ka phase farq hota hai (8.2).

book_ref.quote: are not equal and/or they differ in phase by an arbitrary angle

blocks.prompt:
22 Light passing through a stress plate or a waveplate is an example of:
(Stress plate ya waveplate se guzarne wali light kis ki misaal hai?)
blocks.explanation: Stress plate ya waveplate se guzri light elliptical polarization ki misaal hai (8.2).

book_ref.quote: Example is the light passing through a stress plate or a waveplate.

blocks.prompt:
23 How many basic types of polarization of light are described in the chapter?
(Chapter mein light ki polarization ki kitni bunyadi qismein bayan ki gayi hain?)
blocks.explanation: Bunyadi qismein teen hain: linear, circular aur elliptical polarization (8.2).

book_ref.quote: Here are the basic types of polarization of light.

blocks.text: 8.3 Production and detection of plane polarized light

blocks.prompt:
24 Light from an ordinary incandescent bulb is unpolarized because its electrical vibrations are:
(Aam incandescent bulb ki light unpolarized kyun hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bulb (aur Sooraj) ki light ki vibrations be-tarteeb (randomly) har simt mein hoti hain, is liye unpolarized hai (8.3).

book_ref.quote: is unpolarized, because its (electrical) vibrations are randomly oriented in space

blocks.prompt:
25 When unpolarized light falls on a sheet of polaroid, the transmitted light is:
(Jab unpolarized light polaroid sheet par parti hai to guzarne wali light kaisi hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Polaroid (polarizer) se guzarne wali light plane polarized hoti hai (8.3).

book_ref.quote: If unpolarized light is made incident on a sheet of polaroid (polarizer)

blocks.prompt:
26 In the two-polaroid experiment, the second polaroid which is rotated is called the:
(Do polaroids ke tajurbe mein doosra polaroid jise ghumaya jata hai, kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pehla polaroid polarizer aur doosra (ghumaya jane wala) analyzer kehlata hai (8.3).

book_ref.quote: If the second polaroid (analyzer) is slowly rotated about the beam of light

blocks.prompt:
27 Light emerging from the analyzer disappears when the axes of polarizer and analyzer are:
(Analyzer se nikalne wali light kab ghaib ho jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Analyzer ghumane par light madham hoti hai aur jab dono axes aapas mein amoodi (perpendicular) hon to ghaib ho jati hai (8.3).

book_ref.quote: disappears when the axes become mutually perpendicular

blocks.prompt:
28 The light through the analyzer is brightest when the axes of the two polaroids are:
(Analyzer se guzarne wali light sab se zyada roshan kab hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mazeed ghumane par light wapas aati hai aur jab axes phir mutawazi hon to sab se roshan hoti hai (8.3).

book_ref.quote: becomes brightest when the axes are again parallel to each other

blocks.prompt:
29 The experiment with a polarizer and a rotating analyzer proves that light waves are:
(Polarizer aur ghoomte analyzer wala tajurba kya sabit karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Crossed polaroids par light ka ghaib hona sabit karta hai ke light waves transverse hain (8.3).

book_ref.quote: This experiment proves that light waves are transverse waves.

blocks.prompt:
30 If light waves were longitudinal, then with two mutually perpendicular polaroids the light would:
(Agar light waves longitudinal hoteen to do amoodi polaroids ke saath light ka kya hota?)

options.text: sirf 90° par sab se roshan hoti

blocks.explanation: Longitudinal waves amoodi polaroids ke saath bhi kabhi ghaib na hoteen (8.3).

book_ref.quote: If the light waves were longitudinal, they would never disappear

blocks.prompt:
31 Light reflected from the smooth surface of water is:
(Paani ki hamwar satah se reflect hone wali light kaisi hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ponder Upon box: hamwar paani se reflect hui light satah ke mutawazi juzwi (partially) polarized hoti hai (8.3).

book_ref.quote: Light reflected from smooth surface of water is partially polarized parallel to the surface.

blocks.text: 8.4 Polarized light by the method of reflection

blocks.prompt:
32 The angle of incidence on a transparent medium at which the reflected light is almost plane polarized is called the:
(Shaffaf medium par woh angle of incidence jis par reflect hui light taqreeban plane polarized ho, kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Woh khaas angle of incidence polarizing angle θp kehlata hai (8.4).

book_ref.quote: The particular angle of incidence on a transparent medium when the reflected light is almost plane polarized

blocks.prompt:
33 At the polarizing angle, the angle between the reflected and the refracted beams is:
(Polarizing angle par reflected aur refracted beams ke darmiyan angle kitna hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Polarizing angle par reflected aur refracted beams qaima zaviya (90°) banati hain, yani θp + θr = 90° (8.4).

book_ref.quote: the reflected and refracted beams are at right angle to each other at the polarizing angle

blocks.prompt:
34 Brewster's law for light going from medium 1 (refractive index n1) to medium 2 (refractive index n2) is:
(Medium 1 (n1) se medium 2 (n2) mein jaane wali light ke liye Brewster's law kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: n1 sin θp = n2 cos θp se tan θp = n2/n1 milta hai, yahi Brewster's law hai (8.4).

book_ref.quote: This equation is known as Brewster's law.

blocks.prompt:
35 When medium 1 is air, Brewster's law states that the tangent of the polarizing angle is equal to:
(Jab medium 1 hawa ho to Brewster's law ke mutabiq polarizing angle ka tangent kis ke barabar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hawa ke liye n1 = 1, is liye tan θp = n, yani doosre medium ka refractive index (8.4).

book_ref.quote: the tangent of the angle of polarization is numerically equal to the refractive index

blocks.prompt:
36 The polarizing angle, at which the reflected and refracted rays are at 90°, is also called the:
(Polarizing angle, jis par reflected aur refracted rays 90° par hon, ko aur kya kaha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Woh angle θp jis par reflected aur refracted rays 90° banati hain, Brewster angle θB bhi kehlata hai (8.4).

book_ref.quote: is also called the Brewster angle

blocks.prompt:
37 Light in air falls at the polarizing angle on a material of refractive index 1.6. The polarizing angle is about:
(Hawa se light 1.6 refractive index wale maadde par polarizing angle par girti hai. Polarizing angle taqreeban kitna hai?)

book_ref.quote: A beam of light strikes the surface of a plate of glass with a refractive index

blocks.prompt:
38 Light in air strikes a medium of refractive index 1.8 at the polarizing angle. The angle of refraction is about:
(Hawa se light 1.8 refractive index wale medium par polarizing angle par girti hai. Angle of refraction taqreeban kitna hai?)

39 The polarizing angle for light in air falling on a transparent medium is 52°. The refractive index of the medium is about:
(Hawa se kisi shaffaf medium par light ka polarizing angle 52° hai. Medium ka refractive index taqreeban kitna hai?)

book_ref.quote: If medium 1 is air, then equation becomes

blocks.prompt:
40 In deriving Brewster's law, sin θr is replaced by cos θp because:
(Brewster's law ki derivation mein sin θr ki jagah cos θp kyun likha jata hai?)

options.text: θr = θp at the polarizing angle
θr = 90° − θp at the polarizing angle
θr = 180° − θp at the polarizing angle

blocks.explanation: Kyunke θp + θr = 90°, is liye sin θr = sin(90° − θp) = cos θp (8.4).

book_ref.quote: Let a beam of unpolarized light be made incident on the surface of medium 2

blocks.prompt:
41 Who discovered in 1808 that polarized light is obtained when ordinary light is reflected by a plane sheet of glass?
(1808 mein kis ne daryaft kiya ke aam light sheeshe ki satah se reflect ho to polarized light milti hai?)
blocks.explanation: 1808 mein Malus ne sheeshe se reflection ke zariye polarization daryaft ki (8.4).

book_ref.quote: In 1808, Malus discovered that polarized light is obtained when ordinary light is reflected

blocks.prompt:
42 The most suitable angle of incidence on glass for which the reflected ray becomes plane polarized is about:
(Sheeshe par woh behtareen angle of incidence jis par reflected ray plane polarized ho jati hai, taqreeban kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sheeshe ke liye behtareen angle of incidence taqreeban 57° hai (8.4).

book_ref.quote: The most suitable angle of incidence ‘i’ is about 57° for glass

blocks.prompt:
43 When light reflected from glass at about 57° is viewed through a slowly rotated polaroid, it is:
(Sheeshe se taqreeban 57° par reflect hui light ko ghoomte polaroid se dekha jaye to kya hota hai?)

options.text: aik position par taqreeban bujh jati hai
har position par sab se roshan

blocks.explanation: Polaroid ki aik position par reflected light taqreeban bujh jati hai, jo sabit karta hai ke woh plane polarized hai (8.4).

book_ref.quote: the light is practically extinguished at one position of the polaroid

blocks.prompt:
44 Light reflected from the surface of a table becomes darker when viewed through a rotated polaroid. This shows that the reflected light is:
(Mez ki satah se reflect hui light ghoomte polaroid se dekhne par madham hoti hai. Is se kya zahir hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Madham hona dikhata hai ke mez se reflect hui light juzwi (partially) plane polarized hai (8.4).

book_ref.quote: Light reflected from the surface of a table becomes darker when viewed through a rotated polaroid

blocks.prompt:
45 Light reflected at the polarizing angle is polarized:
(Polarizing angle par reflect hui light kis rukh mein polarized hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Reflected light plane of incidence ke amoodan polarized hoti hai, Fig. 8.6 mein dots se dikhayi gayi (8.4).

book_ref.quote: Reflected light is polarized perpendicular to the plane of incidence

blocks.prompt:
46 Under optics and photonics, polarization is essential for:
(Optics aur photonics mein polarization kin cheezon ke liye zaroori hai?)

options.text: polarized sunglasses, LCD screens aur optical communication systems

blocks.explanation: Polarization polarized sunglasses, LCD screens aur optical communication systems ke liye zaroori hai (8.5).

book_ref.quote: Polarization is essential for applications like polarized sunglasses, LCD

blocks.prompt:
47 In imaging and microscopy, polarization enhances image quality mainly by:
(Imaging aur microscopy mein polarization tasveer ka mayaar kaise behtar karti hai?)

options.text: glare kam kar ke aur contrast behtar kar ke

blocks.explanation: Polarization glare (nazar mein khalal dalne wali ghair-zaroori roshni) kam karti aur contrast behtar karti hai (8.5).

book_ref.quote: reducing glare (unwanted light that interferes with vision)

blocks.prompt:
48 In medicine, polarization is useful because it can:
(Tib (medicine) mein polarization kyun mufeed hai?)

options.text: bacteria ko seedha maar deti hai
tissues ki mukhtalif qismon mein farq kar sakti hai
X-rays ki jagah le leti hai

blocks.explanation: Polarization cancer ki tashkhees, tissue imaging aur laser surgery mein tissues ki mukhtalif qismon mein farq kar ke kaam aati hai (8.5).

book_ref.quote: Polarization is used in cancer diagnosis, tissue imaging, and laser surgery

blocks.prompt:
49 In astronomy, polarization helps to analyze:
(Astronomy (falkiyat) mein polarization kis cheez ka tajziya karne mein madad deti hai?)

options.text: door ke sitaron ki roshni aur cosmic microwave background radiation

blocks.explanation: Polarization door ke sitaron ki roshni aur cosmic microwave background radiation jaise falkiyati mazahir samajhne mein madad deti hai (8.5).

book_ref.quote: or the cosmic microwave background radiation

blocks.prompt:
50 The ability of some substances to rotate the plane of polarization of light passing through them is called:
(Kuch maaddon ki woh salahiyat jis se woh guzarne wali light ka plane of polarization ghuma dete hain, kya kehlati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Optical activity kuch maaddon ki plane of polarization ghumane ki salahiyat hai (8.5).

book_ref.quote: Optical activity is the ability of some substances to rotate the plane of polarization

blocks.prompt:
51 Which of the following is an optically active substance?
(In mein se kaun sa maadda optically active hai?)
blocks.explanation: Quartz, cinnabar (HgS), cheeni ka paani, insulin aur collagen optically active hain (8.5).

book_ref.quote: Examples are quartz crystals, cinnabar (HgS), sugar water, insulin and collagen.

blocks.prompt:
52 The amount of rotation of the plane of polarization by an optically active substance does NOT depend on:
(Optically active maadde se plane of polarization ki gardish (rotation) ki miqdaar kis cheez par munhasir nahi?)

options.text: maadde mein light ka tay kiya faasla

blocks.explanation: Rotation maadde ki qisam, concentration, tay kiye faasle aur wavelength par munhasir hai (8.5).

book_ref.quote: The amount and direction of rotation depends on following factors:

blocks.prompt:
53 Optical activity occurs due to:
(Optical activity kis wajah se hoti hai?)

options.text: molecules ki asymmetric (ghair-mutanasib), maslan helical, shakal

blocks.explanation: Optical activity molecules ki ghair-mutanasib (asymmetric), maslan helical, shakal ki wajah se hoti hai (8.5).

book_ref.quote: Optical activity occurs due to the asymmetric shape of molecules

blocks.prompt:
54 The optical rotation of sugar in solution can be used to determine its:
(Mehlool (solution) mein cheeni ki optical rotation se kya maloom kiya ja sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Optically active maaddon ki is khasiyat se solution mein un ka concentration maloom kiya ja sakta hai (8.5).

book_ref.quote: This property of optically active substances can be used to determine their concentration

blocks.prompt:
55 A few millimetre thickness of an optically active crystal rotates the plane of polarization by:
(Optically active crystal ki chand millimetre motai plane of polarization ko kitna ghumati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aise crystals ki chand millimetre motai plane of polarization ko kayi degrees ghuma deti hai (8.5).

book_ref.quote: A few millimetre thickness of such crystals will rotate the plane of polarization by many degrees

blocks.prompt:
56 A sugar solution placed between crossed polarizer and analyzer lets some light through because it:
(Crossed polarizer aur analyzer ke darmiyan rakha cheeni ka solution kuch light kyun guzarne deta hai?)

options.text: saari light jazb kar leta hai
light ko longitudinal bana deta hai
light ki speed sifar kar deta hai
plane of polarization ko θ angle ghuma deta hai

blocks.explanation: Cheeni ka solution plane of polarization ko θ angle ghuma deta hai, is liye light rokne ke liye analyzer ko ghumana parta hai (8.5).

book_ref.quote: The analyzer thus stops the light when rotated from the vertical

blocks.prompt:
57 Polarized light of intensity 64 W m⁻² passes through an analyzer whose axis is at 30° to the polarizer's axis. The emerging intensity is:
(64 W m⁻² intensity ki polarized light aise analyzer se guzarti hai jis ka axis polarizer ke axis se 30° par hai. Nikalne wali intensity kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: Polarized light with an intensity of 75 W m⁻² passes through an analyzer

blocks.prompt:
58 Polarized light of amplitude 12 units meets an analyzer whose axis is at 60° to its plane of polarization. The transmitted amplitude is:
(12 units amplitude wali polarized light aise analyzer par parti hai jis ka axis us ke plane of polarization se 60° par hai. Guzarne wala amplitude kitna hai?)

book_ref.quote: A polarized light with an amplitude of 5 units passes through a polarizer

blocks.prompt:
59 The polarizing angle for light from air on a liquid is 50°. Its refractive index is about:
(Hawa se aik liquid (maa'e) par light ka polarizing angle 50° hai. Us ka refractive index taqreeban kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: n = tan θp = tan 50° = 1.19 (Example 8.2 ka tareeqa).

book_ref.quote: Find the refractive index of a medium if polarizing angle is 54.5°.

blocks.prompt:
60 When we look through two polarizers that are crossed:
(Jab do crossed polarizers mein se dekha jaye to kya hota hai?)

options.text: light zyada roshan ho jati hai
light circularly polarized ho jati hai

blocks.explanation: Do crossed polarizers mein se bohat kam light guzarti hai (Do you know? box, 8.5).

book_ref.quote: Looking through two polarizers when they are

blocks.prompt:
61 The two main applications of polarizers described in the chapter are:
(Chapter mein polarizers ke kaun se do bare istemalaat bayan kiye gaye hain?)

options.text: sky photography aur maaddon ka stress analysis

blocks.explanation: Do bare istemalaat sky photography aur maaddon ka stress analysis hain (8.5).

book_ref.quote: Polarizers, also known as polarizing filters, have two main applications:

blocks.prompt:
62 In sky photography, the glare and haze reduced by a polarizer are produced by:
(Sky photography mein polarizer jo glare aur haze (dhundlahat) kam karta hai, woh kis se paida hote hain?)

options.text: camera lens se light ka reflection
fiza ke chhote zarraat se light ka bikharna (scattering)

blocks.explanation: Glare aur haze fiza ke chhote zarraat se light ke bikharne (scattering) se paida hote hain (8.5).

book_ref.quote: polarizers are used to reduce the glare and haze which are produced by the scattering of light

blocks.prompt:
63 Analysing the stress patterns in a transparent material by shining polarized light through it is known as:
(Shaffaf maadde mein se polarized light guzaar kar us ke stress patterns ka tajziya karne ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Is technique ko photoelasticity kehte hain; engineering aur quality control mein aam istemal hoti hai (8.5).

book_ref.quote: and is widely used in fields like engineering, materials science, and quality control

blocks.prompt:
64 When a material under polarized light is stressed, its changed molecular structure produces:
(Jab polarized light mein rakhe maadde par stress (dabao) ho to badli hui molecular structure kya paida karti hai?)

options.text: interference fringes jo maadde ki maloomat dete hain
hawa mein light ki speed ki tabdeeli

blocks.explanation: Stress se molecular structure aur light se ta'alluq badalta hai, interference fringes bante hain jo maadde ke baare mein maloomat dete hain (8.5).

book_ref.quote: When a material is stressed, its molecular structure changes

blocks.prompt:
65 Stress analysis of a transparent material with polarized light can help researchers to:
(Polarized light se shaffaf maadde ka stress analysis researchers ki kis kaam mein madad karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Researchers stress patterns, mumkina kamzoriyan ya nuqs (defects) aur optical khasusiyaat maloom kar sakte hain (8.5).
